headline: No dip to buy: BTC $84.9K near the day high on a $648M short squeeze, not new money
summary: There is nothing on sale right now - all three majors sit in the top 10-15% of their day range after a squeeze, not a sell-off. Bitcoin ran from an $81,164 open to an $85,428 high and trades near $84,940 (+4.7% on the day), ETH is near $2,724 (+3.0%) and SOL near $116.79 (+5.1%), with the move driven by $647.9m of forced short covering after bitcoin's first weekly close above its 50-week average in 45 weeks and a fourth straight down session in oil on UN General Assembly diplomacy. The bid is borrowed: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said today it will change the 'geography of the war' and field new weapons if the US strikes again, and Iranian President Pezeshkian only speaks at the UN on Tuesday, so the risk premium crypto stopped paying today can be reinstated by one headline. Macro has not improved either - the Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 16 September in a 12-0 vote, 16 of 19 FOMC members expect at least one more hike this year, and the 10-year Treasury yield is around 5.01%, its highest since 2007. Mood is Greed (composite 64.5, Fear & Greed 70, BTC +9.8% / ETH +9.2% / SOL +15.3% on the week) while the 24h news tone stays negative at -0.73 and daily RSI sits at 71.6 with hourly RSI at 84.8: a stretched chase-or-wait tape, not a bounce setup.

BTC.note: Around $84,940 after covering about 90% of its $80,394-$85,428 day range, its first print above $85,000 since January; Hyperliquid funding is a mild 0.0016%/h (~0.038%/day) on $3.82bn open interest and the futures premium is only 0.058%, so leverage is not yet crowded long - but daily RSI 71.6 and hourly RSI 84.8 with price outside the upper Bollinger band mean any entry here is buying strength, not weakness.

ETH.note: Around $2,724, the laggard of the three at +3.0% on the day and +9.2% on the week, carrying the highest funding of the majors at 0.0028%/h (~0.067%/day) on $3.20bn of Hyperliquid open interest; its fund sponsorship is the weakest - US spot ether ETFs snapped a four-week inflow streak in the week to 18 September.

SOL.note: Around $116.79 and the strongest of the three at +5.1% on the day and +15.3% on the week, with the richest futures premium (0.094%) on a much smaller $720m Hyperliquid book, which makes it the most reflexive of the three in both directions; Alpenglow mainnet activation on 28 September is asset-specific event risk.

drivers.title: The move is forced short covering, and the tape is now stretched
drivers.detail: Bitcoin's push through $85,000 liquidated $647.9m of short positions in 24 hours, roughly $300m of it inside a single hour, after BTC closed the week to 20 September at $81,159 - above its ~$78,786 50-week moving average for the first time in 45 weeks. Nothing about that is spot demand, and the market is now technically extended: daily RSI 71.6, hourly RSI 84.8, price outside the upper Bollinger band on multiple timeframes, total crypto market cap near $2.88tn with BTC dominance 59.1%.

drivers.title: Iran's IRGC threatened a wider war today; today's bid came from oil falling
drivers.detail: IRGC spokesman Hossein Mohebbi said Iran would 'change the weapons and the geography of the war' and bring new capabilities into the field if the US attacks again, that Iran has identified targets not previously hit, and that it is 'prepared for a long-term war' - remarks made as Tehran says it has information the US and allies are preparing a major new strike. This matters because the risk-on bid in crypto today came from Brent falling to a one-week low on hopes UN General Assembly diplomacy defuses the conflict; the Strait of Hormuz dispute, through which about a fifth of global oil once flowed, is unresolved and Pezeshkian only speaks at the UN on Tuesday 22 September.

drivers.title: The Fed is hiking into a 5% 10-year and most of the committee wants more
drivers.detail: The FOMC raised the funds target 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 16 September in a 12-0 vote, the first hike since 2023 and the first under Chair Kevin Warsh, who said inflation is still too high; 16 of 19 members expect at least one further hike this year and the market prices the overnight rate reaching 4.00-4.25%. The Fed's own projections put 2026 headline and core PCE at 3.7% and 3.4% (up from 3.6% and 3.3% in June) with no return to 2% before 2029, and the 10-year Treasury yield is around 5.01% after topping 5.04%, its highest since 2007. The stored history flags this exact transmission channel: 'inflation/CPI' headlines preceded a BTC dip within 6h 2.6% of the time versus 1.0% by chance (2.67x lift, n=117, held in both halves of the data).

drivers.title: Corporates bought under spot; the passive bid did not chase
drivers.detail: Strategy filed an 8-K with the SEC at 12:00 UTC today, its first purchase disclosure in weeks, covering buying in the 14-20 September window when BTC traded well below today's price, and Michael Saylor has been trailing a further move. US spot bitcoin ETFs, by contrast, only swung positive for the week to 18 September on a large Friday inflow and spot ether funds snapped a four-week inflow streak - so the corporate treasury bid is real but the passive flow is not confirming this rally.

drivers.title: Xi lands in Washington with the tariff truce clock running down
drivers.detail: Xi Jinping arrives for his first White House visit in a decade, with a summit on 24 September covering tariffs, rare earths, AI and Taiwan; the two sides are in consultation on a tariff reduction framework covering about $30bn of products on each side, and US and Chinese officials held what both called candid, in-depth talks on tariffs and AI today. Analysts expect stabilisation of a fragile détente rather than a grand bargain, which leaves a two-sided risk event in the middle of the week for every risk asset including crypto.

drivers.title: Regulators are writing rules instead of Congress, and the ECB moves on tokenisation
drivers.detail: With the CLARITY Act stalled, the SEC issued two five-year conditional 'innovation exemptions' on 17 September for permissioned trading of tokenised NMS stock, exempting tokenised securities venues from the exchange definition and certain AMM liquidity providers from the dealer definition, while the CFTC's Market Participants Division issued a no-action position the same day and Chair Michael Selig says his agency is ready to ship its rules. Separately the ECB announced today that the Eurosystem will bring central bank money to tokenised finance via Pontes and will invest part of its own funds in tokenised securities. This lowers structural tail risk over time; it is plumbing, not a bid for spot this week.

watch.what: Iranian President Pezeshkian addresses the UN General Assembly in New York - the single biggest headline risk to the falling-oil bid that is holding today's tape up, in either direction. TON unlocks about 1.3% of supply (~$51.2m) and Messari Mainnet NYC runs 22-24 September.
US flash PMIs, and Xi Jinping arrives in Washington ahead of the summit.

Q2 GDP third estimate and weekly US initial jobless claims both land at 12:30 UTC; Trump hosts Xi at the White House the same day with a state dinner. The data channel matters because 'inflation/CPI' headlines historically preceded BTC dips at 2.67x the base rate.

Deribit quarterly BTC options expiry, around $14.7bn notional - the week's largest mechanical volatility source. Plasma (XPL) also unlocks roughly 1.76-1.81bn tokens, about 63-65% of circulating supply (~$158m), the largest single-token cliff of the quarter.
Solana's Alpenglow mainnet activation, the largest protocol change of the quarter for SOL and the main asset-specific risk in the majors.

BEA Personal Income and Outlays with the next PCE print - the most important read for the Fed's demand-driven-inflation question and October hike pricing (FOMC meets 27-28 October). Q3 and the SEC fiscal year also end on 30 September, which tends to pull flows around.

Context for any pullback that does appear, from the stored history: BTC dips during greed recovered +1.5% in 7 of 7 cases, ETH in 92.9% of 28 and SOL in 93.8% of 48, with a typical extra drop after the trigger of -0.3% to -0.5% and a median time to recovery of 3.5-5.0 hours. Against that, today's market state most resembles 2025-07-10, 2025-06-10 and 2024-07-22, after which BTC's median 30-day move was -3.0% (up in 50.0% of them).
